name: Adachi Ballin'
summary: This game is a 3D basketball action game. The player plays against AI controlled players to score points, and the first to score seven baskets wins. Players can move around the court, dribble and steal the ball, aim and adjust the power of their shots, and switch between different camera views. The game features an SP system, as well as standard basketball mechanics where players can call upon Persona attacks that can knock opponents into a ragdoll state and cause them to lose possession of the ball. AI opponents are able to chase down loose balls, steal possession, shoot the ball at the basket, and use their own Persona attacks during matches.
